chapter: Army, Grunewald and Guitar Slim's band
title: Meeting Lloyd Lambert and joining Guitar Slim's band
summary: Under the GI Bill he met bassist Lloyd Lambert, played the Happiest Corral and Jose Hill's Tibidore club, left his rug-company job and went on the road in Lloyd's band with Slim; he names the band members and Turk Girard's nickname.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
